_comment: Worked example of a GitHub profile. Identical to profiles/acme except `forge` is 'github' and each team lists `githubRepos` (owner/repo) instead of `gitlabGroups`. Everything is fictional. GitHub has no nested-group concept, so there is no `suggest-groups` step - list the repos each team owns by hand. Non-secret, safe to commit; the token goes in secrets.local.json.
_reviewBotAccounts_note: On GitHub the tool already excludes anything whose account type is 'Bot' or whose login ends in '[bot]' (dependabot[bot], renovate[bot], ...). This list is only for CI/service accounts created as ordinary users - list the login, and the display name too if they differ.

teams.description: Board 701 'Web Platform Scrum' (WEB). Repos owned by this team on GitHub - the PR review metrics are scoped to exactly these.
